subject: Phased evaluation roadmap & MAP template request
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@novushealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Phased evaluation roadmap & MAP template request

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the throughput numbers look promising for our use case. The execs asked for a concise mutual action plan we can use internally to justify a 30/60/90 pilot cadence.

Can you share a MAP template (Google Doc or Slides) that breaks the evaluation into phases, owner roles (Novus vs Redwood), success criteria per phase, and a suggested close timeline? Ideally we want a single doc to share with engineering, procurement, and the sponsoring PM.

A few constraints:
- Data residency notes: we need to call out where we will run the POC (prod-like for a short window).
- Security checkpoint: SOC2 evidence and a short list of what your team will provide for our security questionnaire.

Looping in Liam (cc) from our platform team. Would appreciate a seed doc we can iterate on.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Turner
Head of Platform Integrations
Novus Health
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@novushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-02T13:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Phased evaluation roadmap & MAP template request

Alex — really great to meet yesterday. Appreciate the clear asks.

I created a seeded Google Doc (link below) that follows a 3-phase approach: Pilot (14 days), Expanded Pilot (30 days), and Acceptance->Close (60 days). The doc includes:
- Executive summary and decision criteria (sponsor signoff)
- Phase-by-phase objectives, owners (Novus / Redwood), and deliverables
- Technical checkpoints (integration, latency/cost targets, dataset handling)
- Security/compliance checklist and owner for each item
- Suggested dates and an acceptance signoff template

Seed doc: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2bPhasedEvalSeed

Proposed immediate owners (happy to change):
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (Success) — overall MAP coordination; Ben Carter (Eng) — infra readiness + perf gates
- Novus: Alex Turner (Platform lead) — internal alignment; Liam Chen (Eng) — integration owner

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll share the seed doc as editable for your team.
2) Marissa and I will run a 30-minute co-edit session with your platform and security leads to assign owners and firm dates.
3) We’ll add the SOC2 evidence links and the minimal artifact list you need for your security questionnaire.

Attachments: phased-eval-template.gdoc (seed) — shared.

If that works I can schedule the co-edit for early next week.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Turner <alex.turner@novushealth.com>
Date: 2025-07-03T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Phased evaluation roadmap & MAP template request

Naomi — thanks for the seed. I skimmed and added a short section for a technical readiness gate after phase 1: a sandbox integration test with a perf target (p95 < 220ms and cost per 1k tokens under your budget cap). Also added a one-page exec slide (30-60-90 MAP Slides.pptx) that summarizes milestones, owners, and signoff artifacts.

Would propose we schedule the co-edit on Monday 7/7 at 10:00 PT — will invite Ben to cover infra details.

Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@novushealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Liam Chen <liam.chen@novushealth.com>
Date: 2025-07-03T12:49:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Phased evaluation roadmap & MAP template request

Thanks Naomi and Marissa — that timeline looks good. Liam and I confirmed Monday 7/7 10:00 PT works. A couple of asks prior to the co-edit:
- Can you add a short procurement lane (who signs what and estimated approval lead times) — we have a procurement checkpoint that often takes ~2 weeks once SOW is accepted.
- Please include a minimal SOW checklist so we can start internal approvals in parallel.

If you can attach a starter SOW (pdf) to the doc I’ll have our legal and procurement take a quick look before the session.

Appreciate it — Alex
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@novushealth.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-06T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Phased evaluation roadmap & MAP template request

Alex — adding the starter SOW (sow-draft_v1.pdf) to the Drive doc now and I updated the procurement lane to reflect typical signers and a 10–15 business day review + countersign expectation. Also expanded the security checklist to reference SOC2 report pages and where to find exportable audit logs for the pilot window.

I attached the one-page slide pack (30-60-90 MAP Slides.pptx) to keep the exec summary tight for your sponsor meeting. Ready for the co-edit on 7/7 — invite incoming.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachments: sow-draft_v1.pdf (starter SOW), 30-60-90 MAP Slides.pptx
